scripts.dev: npm run db:generate -w @marketpulse/api && npm run build -w @marketpulse/contracts && node scripts/dev.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build -w @marketpulse/contracts && npm run build -w @marketpulse/api && npm run build -w @marketpulse/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run db:generate -w @marketpulse/api && npm run build -w @marketpulse/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @marketpulse/contracts && npm run test:auth && npm run test:web && npm run test:markets
scripts.worker:dev: npm run db:generate -w @marketpulse/api && npm run build -w @marketpulse/contracts && npm run worker:dev -w @marketpulse/api
